##### Project general facts

Palazzo Tissoli is a distinctive waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, created in collaboration with Pininfarina. The architecture reflects a seamless fusion of art, design, and coastal nature, inspired by the meeting of desert, sea, and mountains in Ras Al Khaimah. Flowing terraces, sculpted façades, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf define the project’s identity, while every detail expresses Italian precision and a contemporary vision of refined living.

The residences include fully furnished studios and one-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to balance elegance and practicality. Interiors feature a warm palette of stone, wood, and glass, enriched with bespoke lighting and refined detailing. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance the sense of space and openness, creating a seamless connection between indoor living areas and the surrounding coastal landscape, with views extending toward the Wynn Resort and the sea.

Palazzo Tissoli offers a comprehensive lifestyle experience centered around wellness, leisure, and community. Residents have access to multiple swimming pools, rooftop lounges, landscaped gardens, and a curated selection of dining venues. Additional amenities such as a private cinema, cigar lounge, co-working spaces, yoga loft, and lagoon-style pools create a vibrant yet balanced environment, bringing together design, comfort, and a modern waterfront lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
